{{Quote
|Pilgrim of Pharloom eternal, regale us with our Threefold song, that you may rise above and worship before our kingdom's divine heart. 
|[[Cogwork Statues]]
|Hr=SS
}}
The <b>Threefold Melody</b> is the main goal of the <i>[[ASCEND: Pharloom's Crown]]</i> [[Objectives|objective]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. The <i>[[LEARN: Conductor's Melody]]</i>, <i>[[LEARN: Architect's Melody]]</i>, and <i>[[LEARN: Vaultkeeper's Melody]]</i> objectives need to be completed to learn the Threefold Melody.

== Use ==
Can be played at the lift to [[the Cradle]] to open the path to it.

{{Gallery
|Image1 = Mapshot SS Cogwork Dancers.png!Location to play the Threefold Melody
|Image2 = Screenshot SS Threefold Melody 01.png!Lift and statues to play the Threefold Melody
}}

== How to Acquire ==
The Threefold Melody is learned after first learning the three separate parts of the sequence:
<h3>Conductor's Melody</h3>
The Conductor's Melody can be learned from [[Conductor Ballador]] in the [[High Halls]], after an enemy [[Enemy Gauntlets (Silksong)/High Halls 1|gauntlet]] in [[the Forum]].

{{Gallery
|Image1 = Mapshot SS Conductor's Melody.png!Conductor's Melody location in the High Halls
|Image2 = Screenshot SS Conductor Ballador 01.png!Conductor Ballador in the High Halls
}}

<h3>Architect's Melody</h3>
The Architect's Melody can be learned from the cogwork constructs at the top of the [[Cogwork Core]], after completing the puzzle there.

{{Gallery
|Image1 = Mapshot SS Architect's Melody.png!Architect's Melody location in the Cogwork Core
|Image2 = Screenshot SS Threefold Melody 03.png!Architect's Melody puzzle solution
|Image3 = Screenshot SS Threefold Melody 04.png!Architect's Melody cogwork constructs
}}

<h3>Vaultkeeper's Melody</h3>
The Vaultkeeper's Melody can be learned after obtaining the [[Psalm Cylinder|Sacred Cylinder]] from the body of the pontiff in the [[Whispering Vaults]], and then asking [[Vaultkeeper Cardinius]] to play it.

{{Gallery
|Image1 = Mapshot SS Sacred Cylinder.png!Sacred Cylinder location in the Whispering Vaults
|Image2 = Screenshot SS Threefold Melody 05.png!Pontiff corpse holding the Sacred Cylinder
}}

{{Gallery
|Image1 = Mapshot SS Vaultkeeper Cardinius.png!Vaultkeeper Cardinius location in the Whispering Vaults
|Image2 = Screenshot SS Vaultkeeper Cardinius 01.png!Vaultkeeper Cardinius in Whispering Vaults
}}

== Trivia ==
* Although the melodies are presented to Hornet by the statues in the order of Architect's, Vaultkeeper's, Conductor's, the order in which the final melody is composed is that of Conductor's, Vaultkeeper's, Architect's.
** This results in the Architect and Conductor statue having their songs swapped when the full melody is played.
* Despite the Cogwork Statues describing the melodies in possession to groups, they are named in singular possessives. 
** In some translations of the game, this discrepancy does not occur.
* It is possible to buy the [[Gramophone]] for Hornet's [[Bellhome]] before learning the Vaultkeeper's Melody (by giving the [[Sacred Cylinder]] to [[Vaultkeeper Cardinius]] without playing it). However it is not possible to learn the melody from the gramophone this way.
